units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:1">B. Mets. VII, 1</cite> <he>מִנְהַג המדינה</he> the usage of the country.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:13">Tosef. ib. VII, 13</cite> <he>מ׳ הולכי שיירא</he> the usage among members of a caravan; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:14">ib. 14</cite> <he>מ׳ הספנין</he> the usage of shippers (in cases of jetsam).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:7">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ</cite> top <he>אינו מ׳</he> this is no religious usage (deserving recognition); <he>מ׳</he> it is &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 13b:4">Ḥull. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>נכרים … אלא מ׳ אבותיהן בידיהן</he> the gentiles outside of Palestine are not to be considered as idolaters, they only continue the usages of their ancestors.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:14">Ab. Zar. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>עולם כמִנְהָגוֹ נוהג</he> the world (nature) follows its laws. Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 168ᵃ, v. <cite ref="M01711"><he>מַנְגָּנוֹן</he></cite>: a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִנְהָגִים</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:1">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <he>מִנְהָגָיו</he> its arrangements, v. <cite ref="M01711"><he>מַנְגָּנוֹן</he></cite>.
